generator.fallback_rule: tune natural non_claim share > 0.5, decided before check labels are read
generator.runtime: host Ollama 0.35.0 (Metal, M1 Pro); same model digest. Docker CPU (4-core cap) took 3-10 min per answer and timed out

labels.reconcile: one round with the other labeler's label and reason, then disputed (excluded, sensitivity reported)

stage0_measure.h_ko: JEV score = max p(supports) over 8 passages, natural claims of the check split, final labels excluding disputed and non_claim
stage0_measure.latency: first attempts of batched requests (tags other than single)
stage0_measure.question_tuning: tune split only, at most 3 wording revisions, each logged

stop: any gate fails -> NO-GO, publish the report, move to module B if h_ko fails

stage1.llm_prompt: 당신은 근거 판정자입니다. [문단]들 중 하나가 [주장]의 모든 사실을 그대로 뒷받침하는 정도를 0~100 사이 정수 하나로만 답하세요. 뒷받침하지 않거나 어긋나면 0에 가깝게 답하세요.

labelers.codex: codex-cli 0.159.3→0.160.0, model gpt-6.1-sol, run with -c mcp_servers={}

notes: B*=lex because generator answers copy passage wording; SYS tune AUC 0.971 vs lex 0.953
tau_s=0.50 by prereg rule (smallest with tune precision>=0.90); Stage 0 showed repeat flips near 0.5 — product threshold decided separately in A-2
MDE 0.083 <= 0.10: holdout keeps 6 questions per company
